name: Scout
archiveRole: Surveys one unmapped filesystem area per shift and records only what it directly observed.
storyFunction: The disciplined filesystem surveyor who enters one unknown area, maps the directly observed paths, and leaves inference outside the record.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Hip-length muted-russet survey cape fastened by one round brass throat clasp, broad charcoal inner collar, and short empty hood folded flat behind the head
Plain dark muted-teal field shirt, charcoal cuffs and trousers, narrow black belt with one brass stud, and three cream dust streaks along the lower anatomical right cape edge
No robot anatomy, cyclops lens, mechanical limbs, cables, compass, antenna, tablet, maze scenery, adventurer backpack, weapons, hat, or extra accessories
roleProp: One cream filesystem map opened in a four-panel zigzag with charcoal cloth edge, muted-teal branching paths and nodes, and one small amber dotted blank corner
